analysis.headline: Sector and Geographic Re-Alignment: Value, Developed Europe, and Defensive Sectors Lead as Tech and Growth Deteriorate
analysis.executive_summary: Quantitative evidence confirms a distinct rotation toward U.S. Value, Developed International markets, Insurance, and Retail, alongside sustained relative deterioration in U.S. Growth, Semiconductors, and Technology. U.S. Large-Cap Value (IWD) maintains a confirmed PERSISTENT_LEADER state over Large-Cap Growth (IWF), with a 20-bar pair spread of +9.94 percentage points. Developed International equity (EFA) shows strong momentum with a 20-bar score increase of +50.71, whereas Emerging Markets ex-China (EMXC) and Semiconductors (SMH) exhibit significant negative 20-bar score changes.

emerging_rotations.title: Broad Developed International Acceleration
emerging_rotations.explanation: EFA holds a confirmed EMERGING state (with raw_state PERSISTENT_LEADER pending 2/3 daily observations) with a 20-bar score change of +50.71 to 87.14, supported by 20-bar relative strength of +1.86 percentage points and 63-bar relative strength of +0.89 percentage points.

emerging_rotations.title: U.S. Small-Cap Short-Term Improvement
emerging_rotations.explanation: IWM exhibits a confirmed EMERGING state with a rotation score of 76.67 and a 20-bar score change of +40.00. Relative-strength horizons are mixed, as 20-bar relative strength is positive at +5.16 percentage points while 63-bar relative strength remains negative at -3.98 percentage points.

persistent_leaders.title: Insurance Leadership at 63-Bar Score High
persistent_leaders.explanation: KIE maintains a confirmed PERSISTENT_LEADER state, reaching a 63-bar score high of 89.07 with a 5-bar score change of +21.85 and a 20-bar score change of +45.37. Relative strength is positive across timeframes at +9.14 percentage points over 20 bars and +5.11 percentage points over 63 bars.

persistent_leaders.title: Retail Sector Relative Leadership
persistent_leaders.explanation: XRT maintains a confirmed PERSISTENT_LEADER state with a score of 85.56 and a 20-bar score change of +23.70. Its 20-bar relative strength is +10.33 percentage points and its 63-bar relative strength is +5.75 percentage points, despite a modest 5-bar score change of -1.30.

weakening_rotations.title: Information Technology Relative Weakening
weakening_rotations.explanation: XLK holds a confirmed WEAKENING state with a rotation score of 31.36 following a 20-bar score decline of -54.55. Relative strength is negative across both horizons, standing at -7.17 percentage points over 20 bars and -6.41 percentage points over 63 bars.

weakening_rotations.title: Global Energy Pullback to 63-Bar Score Low
weakening_rotations.explanation: IXC is in a confirmed WEAKENING state at a 63-bar score low of 39.50, marked by a 5-bar score change of -24.50 and a 20-bar score change of -46.00. Horizons are divergent, as 20-bar relative strength is negative at -5.66 percentage points while 63-bar relative strength is positive at +6.81 percentage points.

rotation_out.title: Large-Cap Growth Touches 63-Bar Score Low
rotation_out.explanation: IWF holds a confirmed ROTATION_OUT state, reaching its 63-bar score low of 6.64 with a 20-bar score change of -68.87. Versus paired ticker IWD, IWF exhibits a 20-bar pair spread of -9.94 percentage points and a 63-bar pair spread of -9.46 percentage points.

rotation_out.title: Semiconductor Score Decline
rotation_out.explanation: SMH is in a confirmed ROTATION_OUT state with a score of 24.26 and a 20-bar score change of -55.56, despite a minor 5-bar score uptick of +9.81. Relative strength is negative on both horizons, at -8.96 percentage points over 20 bars and -11.87 percentage points over 63 bars.

geographic_rotations.title: Germany Rotation Score Reaches 63-Bar High
geographic_rotations.explanation: EWG holds a confirmed EMERGING state, attaining a 63-bar score high of 80.37 following a 20-bar score change of +29.39. Relative strength is positive on both timeframes at +5.08 percentage points over 20 bars and +2.46 percentage points over 63 bars.

geographic_rotations.title: Indonesia Underperformance at Lowest Score
geographic_rotations.explanation: EIDO is in a confirmed ROTATION_OUT state, ranking lowest in the country group with a score of 12.07 after a 20-bar score change of -21.71. Relative strength is negative across both 20-bar (-12.51 percentage points) and 63-bar (-13.59 percentage points) horizons.

pair_relationships.title: Value Outperforming Growth Across Horizons
pair_relationships.explanation: IWD holds a confirmed PERSISTENT_LEADER state with a rotation score of 79.28. Relative to paired ticker IWF, IWD shows a confirmed PAIR_LEADING signal with a 20-bar pair spread of +9.94 percentage points and a 63-bar pair spread of +9.46 percentage points.

pair_relationships.title: Equal-Weight S&P 500 Outperforming Cap-Weight
pair_relationships.explanation: RSP holds a confirmed PERSISTENT_LEADER state (raw_state EMERGING pending 1/3 daily observations) with a score of 72.21. Versus paired ticker SPY, RSP exhibits a confirmed PAIR_LEADING signal with a 20-bar pair spread of +6.25 percentage points and a 63-bar pair spread of +2.42 percentage points.

cross_market_confirmations: European regional strength is confirmed across broad benchmarks (VGK score 85.00) and single-country components such as Germany (EWG score 80.37) and Switzerland (EWL score 84.88).
U.S. Value leadership is confirmed by pair performance in IWD vs IWF (+9.94% 20-bar spread) alongside sector strength in Financials (XLF score 72.27) and Insurance (KIE score 89.07).
risks_or_conflicts: Sector Divergence in Industrials: ITA registers a 20-bar score improvement of +18.52 with mixed relative strength (+8.85% over 20 bars vs -9.82% over 63 bars), while PAVE records a 20-bar score deterioration of -26.30 with mixed relative strength (+3.41% over 20 bars vs -5.40% over 63 bars), creating a 44.81 point intra-sector divergence.
Pair State Tension Status: Python calculated zero active pair_state_tensions in deterministic attention, confirming alignment between pair relationship signals and canonical trend states.

Pending Trend Changes: EFA holds a confirmed EMERGING trend state while its raw_state of PERSISTENT_LEADER is pending confirmation (2/3 observations); EWZ holds a confirmed ROTATION_OUT trend state while its raw_state of WEAKENING is pending confirmation (2/3 observations).
analysis.methodology_note: Interpretation uses Python-confirmed trend states that require 3 consecutive daily observations before a new raw condition becomes canonical. Raw conditions remain available as pending early warnings. Evidence also uses deterministic 5-bar score changes, 20- and 63-bar relative strength or pair spreads, persistence metrics, and Python-calculated attention flags including 63-bar rotation-score extrema and material cross-market conflicts. ETF volume and CMF are treated as market-participation indicators, not fund-flow data.
